teaser: Villager services for explorer coders: founders with ten years of checklists build the apps; we sell everything behind them in finite packs.
core_idea: Founders with years of refined checklists are the ultimate product managers and will build apps with AI, hitting every non-functional requirement because the loop is addictive; villager services release what they built without changing it, deployed, locked down, tested, private by passkey and vault, with agents contained on a schedule, so it breaks less and more people use it; users pay for use after the value, explorers buy finite packs and share revenue and sell it to people who trust them, and the villager service itself is town-planned into a commodity.
